name: Lucee
description: Lucee is a high-performance, open-source CFML server written in Java. Supporting JDBC, Caching, Parallelism, HTTP, ORM, REST, S3 and dynamic Java integration, Lucee is great for developers aiming to build fast, scalable applications, delivering faster startup, rapid compilation and better runtime performance.
